This is directly compatible with the general reduction-completeness meta-principle, which states that reductions transfer guarantees and organize problem classes. The principle is a specialization of that general reduction framework, with compatible variables (truthfulness-testing and monotonicity-testing problems), compatible scale (algorithmic property testing within the same formal setting), and compatible epistemic type (formal proposition). No other candidate meta-principle is needed or sufficiently aligned; the PCP theorem and revelation principle are only thematically related and do not provide the same direct grounding.
